description: getContactsForDomain: Get all contacts (registrant, admin, tech, billing) assigned to a domain. Requires authentication. Returns the contact assigned to each role.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name whose contacts to fetch, e.g. 'example.com'.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: getContactsForDomain
